summary: Sign-ins are now checked with Microsoft's own library - no custom sign-in code is left.

fixes.title: Microsoft's library checks every sign-in
fixes.text: The web app and the engine check each person's Microsoft sign-in with Microsoft's own library instead of code of ours. Microsoft's built-in sign-in still stands in front of the web app.

fixes.title: The registry clean-up reports correctly
fixes.text: Once the last earlier sign-in image is removed, the clean-up now reports the registry as empty instead of a warning.
